test_title: PYST 49: SSC CPO - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: Let the speed of the boat in still water be 17 km/h and let the speed of the stream be 5 km/h. What is the time taken by the boat to go 110 km downstream?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Downstream speed = Speed of boat + Speed of stream = 17 + 5 = 22 km/h.

Time = Distance ÷ Downstream speed = 110 ÷ 22 = 5 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 5 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of boat in still water = 17 km/h

Speed of stream = 5 km/h

Distance to travel downstream = 110 km

**Formula Used:**

Downstream Speed = Speed of boat in still water + Speed of stream

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2103eedb8205a8f51ef5c551e767c949f21f015ec296db194dcfb5f7c5247974.png] 

**Calculation:**

⇒ Downstream speed = 17 + 5 = 22 km/h

⇒ Time taken = Distance ÷ Downstream speed

⇒ Time taken = 110 ÷ 22

⇒ Time taken = 5 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 5 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Upstream Speed

Upstream speed is the relative speed of the boat when traveling against the flow of the river. Formula: Upstream Speed = Speed of boat in still water − Speed of stream.

Speed of Boat in Still Water

If both downstream and upstream speeds are given, you can calculate the boat's speed as: Speed of boat = (Downstream Speed + Upstream Speed) ÷ 2.

Speed of Stream

Similarly, the speed of the current can be found using: Speed of stream = (Downstream Speed − Upstream Speed) ÷ 2.
